comments.name: The name of the package.
comments.private: Indicates that the package is private and should not be published to the npm registry.
comments.type: Specifies the module type for the package. In this case, it is set to 'module' to indicate that the package uses ECMAScript modules.

scripts.dev: A script to start the development server using Vite.
scripts.build: A script to build the project using TypeScript and Vite.
scripts.lint: A script to run ESLint on the project files.
scripts.preview: A script to preview the built project using Vite.

dependencies.lucide-react: A library for using Lucide icons in React applications.
dependencies.react: The React library for building user interfaces.
dependencies.react-dom: The React DOM library for rendering React components in the browser.
dependencies.tailwindcss: A utility-first CSS framework for styling web applications.

devDependencies.eslint: A tool for identifying and fixing problems in JavaScript code.
devDependencies.eslint-plugin-react-hooks: ESLint plugin for enforcing rules of React Hooks.
devDependencies.eslint-plugin-react-refresh: ESLint plugin for React Fast Refresh support.
devDependencies.globals: A library providing global variables for various environments.
devDependencies.typescript: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript.
devDependencies.typescript-eslint: TypeScript parser and plugin for ESLint.
devDependencies.vite: A fast build tool and development server for modern web projects.
